author: JayVagabond
quote: Don’t believe the critics. 1 whole week before the launch & there’s already scripted bought reviews for this game. Another Mixtape case propaganda at play again to brainwash everyone this is a GOTY contender. Laughable. Loyal fans like me waited 13 years for a supposedly true sequel only to be squandered by a risky business decision of deviating from the tried & true formula of true power fantasy & guilt free virtual simulation to do crime but now they took things too far by making your character as honorable as Arthur Morgan from RDR2 being loyal to a fault for the wrong partner that treats him like a personal slave. 10 hours in & everyone is still doing chores. Makes me wonder if the feminist writers are secretly taking revenge on modern men due to the older generation of men’s sins by making them do chores for the years & years of stereotypes that women  do household chores & worst of all they make you wait 13 years for this humiliation ritual so you won’t second guess on paying $100 for a mind programming game to make men into Beta Goy Soy Boys. Loads of bugs too on launch. What goes around comes around when Cuckstar Games made fun of Project CD Red’s Cyberpunk 2077 day 1 launch. Now they have to walk the same karmic road by fixing this slop for 5-6 years same thing Cyberpunk did in order to redeem themselves of this $100 waste of time chore Beta Goy Soy Boy simulator that potentially makes males develop NTR fetish for Femme Fetales. Waste of development time & money. Spoiler alert it’s a flop & buyable at $10 at best. They need to pay us for forcing this crap at our throats.
